Boston-based Aevius Labs Inc., a clinical medical data company, today announced it has raised $22 million in funding led by Insight Partners to build and train artificial intelligence foundation models that can understand and query unstructured medical text, imaging and other data. A spinout of Mass General Brigham, a nonprofit academic healthcare system in Massachusetts, […]
